blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More than a month after the historic election in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM), Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua announced the composition of his Cabinet, designating officials to lead the ministries and offices of the regional government. READ: Macacua names new BARMM Cabinet members BARMM is the only region in the Philippines with its own government, parliament, chief minister and Cabinet, allowing it to manage regional affairs under a parliamentary-democratic system established through Republic Act No. 11054, or the Bangsamoro Organic Law (BOL).
